phases.title: Book: fact-check against primary sources (all 4 queues + continuous read §1/§4/§6/§7/§9) + reference-page proofreading + Site: rhythm/spacing canon and registration forms
phases.summary: Two parallel tracks, ~380 commits (per-commit detail in git log, not restated here). BOOK: TASKS.md 92-item plan approved by owner 2026-08-12, order set by clinical cost of error — §8 Treatment → §3 Epidemiology → §10 Myths → §2 History. This is distinct from the April/May translation-vs-master proofreading: here the az master itself is checked against the primary source each card names (NICE/APA/WFSBP/FDA/PubMed/WHO ICD-11 MMS browser), a defect class earlier passes couldn't see because they only compared languages to each other. Queue 1 (§8, 23 chapters/104 cards) closed 2026-08-17. Queue 2 (§3, same scope) closed 2026-08-18, 12 discrepancies incl. one false claim (ru/6B65 compared partial DID to BPD instead of full DID). Also closed: task D (§11 bibliography, 76 entries restored across trees, one wrong citation replaced after PubMed check), task E (103/104 az titles and codes verified against the live WHO ICD-11 MMS browser — tr/6C72 had drifted to a different disorder's title in 417 places), task F/I (26 'DSM-parallel/same' claims read, 14 were false and rewritten), branch cleanup (repo had 4 branches, 2 unmergeable without reverting later fixes — tagged as archive/* and deleted, one main branch remains), az-tree structural pass (§8 unified across 4 trees, English purged from az prose, table-header defects). Queue 3 (§10 Myths, 23/23 chapters) closed 2026-08-24, 6 discrepancies across 5 cards (6A00, 6A05, 6A21, 6A20, 6A60, 6B66). Queue 4 (§2 History, 23/23) closed 2026-08-24, 5 discrepancies across 3 cards (6B02 Westphal date, 6B20 co-author error, 6B66 Krishaber date). Task R (7 citations in §3 with no §11 entry) closed — all 7 inserted across the 6 cards that needed them (6A01, 6A20, 6B23, 6B44, 6D10, 6D31), plus a Bleichhardt/Hiller journal-name side-finding. Continuous read of §1 Tarif, §4 Etiologiya, §7 Muayine, §9 Proqnoz (§6 Diaqnoz was already 104/104 from an earlier pass) closed 2026-08-24 — 416 card-sections, 2 defects: 6B02 §4 (Mosing 2009 agoraphobia heritability, 60%→48%) and 6A40 §9 (malignant catatonia mortality — treated/untreated figures had been swapped, book said "10-20% untreated" when untreated mortality is historically ~50%+ and 10-20% is the modern TREATED figure — clinically significant, understated the emergency's danger). Also corrected a false premise inherited from an earlier session summary: there is no §9 "Metodikalar" section in the book — the template is always 11 sections and §9 is "Proqnoz". Re-verified (task E/G from this same phase) 104/104 codes against WHO ICD-11 MMS and chapters 7/8/16/17 against their named guidelines (AASM/AAN-ESSTS/ISPMD/ISSWSH-ISSM-AUA-EAU) — found one further defect task G's first pass had missed: 7A41 asserted as settled fact in three places (§8, §9, and a §10 "myth busted") that CPAP reduces cardiovascular mortality, citing only the observational Marin Lancet 2005 study; subsequent RCTs (SAVE, NEJM 2016) did not confirm this, likely due to poor trial adherence — reworded with both evidence lines in all 4 languages. Reference pages (index/mugeddime/kitab-haqqinda/terminoloji-luget/mundericat/abbreviatur) read for the first time with any lens — prosecheck.py's pages() explicitly excludes them — via a one-off prosecheck_refs.py reusing its regexes without touching the tool; found 3 defects: a broken intro paragraph shared by terminoloji-luget.html and abbreviatur.html (ru had a duplicated predicate «представлены…представлено» in one sentence, en had the same duplication with a missing separator, tr only had a Title Case slip — the az master was clean throughout); tr/kitab-haqqinda.html used Azerbaijani spelling «kitab» instead of Turkish «kitap» (the only occurrence in the whole tr tree); en/kitab-haqqinda.html was missing «The» before «World Health Organization». Also confirmed (0 hits) that the «phrase-structure» lens (participial-construction reversal, caps-mid-phrase) is now closed across the ENTIRE book, not just §1/§10 as an earlier note said — prosecheck.py's caps/hang checks scan the whole card, all sections, not a subset. PROOFREADING.md is now fully closed except nine explicit [?] items awaiting the owner's stylistic call (Приложение B/Б localization, English-vs-translated WHO name in brackets, «imitated» vs «artificial» disorder naming, etc.) — intentionally untouched.
